name: ClinuxFlowOnboardingGraph
description: The real reference-structure graph between the onboarding entities (SPEC-24 §3) — describes which resources link to which, for two real, honest jobs: (1) $graph-style bundle assembly, and (2) as the STRUCTURAL half of next-best-action derivation (src/lib/next-best-action.js) — a link's target is only actionable once its source exists and is Profile-valid. Deliberately does NOT carry sequence/time semantics itself (real FHIR GraphDefinition can't; see SPEC-24 §3's own honest split) — business-rule ordering lives in each StructureDefinition's own invariants instead. Deliberately scoped to the 4 orchestration entities (Facility/Provider/ProviderRole/Affiliate x2) — Patient is NOT a node here: Patient capture is staff-mediated, part of the clinical/Front-Desk flow, not this onboarding graph (SPEC-21 §6's own resolution), so it has no real structural dependency on Facility/Provider to model.
